title: Working Moms Podcast | Ep. 6 — Dealing with Gossip
description:
Working Moms Podcast | Ep. 6 — Graduation Chaos, $14K Couches & Dealing with Gossip

Welcome back to another unfiltered episode of Working Moms (formerly Working Moms in Real Estate)! This week, we're talking all things real-life mom chaos, graduation week madness, ridiculous furniture shopping experiences, and diving into a surprisingly heartfelt conversation about gossip, trust, and what it means to be a real friend.

💡 In This Episode:
Graduation season + hosting a house full of family 🧑‍🎓🏡
$14,000 for a couch?! Our worst furniture store moment yet 😤🛋️
Beauty hack of the week: Crimped hair is back (or is it?) 💇‍♀️🔥
The THINK method: Is your convo building up or breaking down? 🧠💬
Gossip in adulthood — and why we’re keeping our circles small 💕
Why we're changing our podcast name (spoiler: it’s NOT just about real estate anymore)

Whether you're juggling school drop-offs, showing houses, or just trying to finish your coffee while it's still hot — this one’s for you. Let’s laugh, learn, and love our way through this journey of motherhood and womanhood together.
